scope: One non-bare Native -p session loaded the temporary plugin, executed its session.start hook, and completed one model exchange with a local-only Anthropic Messages stub. This is a narrow runtime acceptance, not full Mods API parity or general network-isolation proof.

source_chunks.label: Extracted root Commander source chunk
source_chunks.meaning: Contains common preAction, print and plugin-dir option definitions. Hash is the extracted source-chunk hash; the individual source_ranges below are byte-sliced directly from the Native binary.

source_ranges.label: Installed hook module gate Bwn and rollout default
source_ranges.meaning: Bwn = !Nt() && k(tengu_plugin_hooks_modules, true) && !hooks-disabled && !safe-mode && !managed-policy-disabled. --bare/simple makes Nt() veto installed Mods.

source_ranges.label: Native installed-hook rollout refusal
source_ranges.meaning: pFo returns without refusal only when XD() is true; otherwise it logs the rollout-flag refusal.

source_ranges.label: Simple/bare predicate used by Nt
source_ranges.meaning: Or() is true for CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE or --bare.

source_ranges.label: Telemetry mode Ivt and non-default predicate YL
source_ranges.meaning: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC yields essential-traffic; DISABLE_TELEMETRY or parsed-true DO_NOT_TRACK yields no-telemetry; either is non-default. This is not a general network firewall.

source_ranges.label: Native first-party preconnect HEAD /api/hello
source_ranges.meaning: When first-party and no proxy, Unix socket, or client certificate is configured, Native sends HEAD to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/api/hello. The reviewed stub answers only on loopback and does not relay.

source_ranges.label: Startup legacy credential service lookups and Aeo prefetch
source_ranges.meaning: Aeo invokes security find-generic-password twice unless Or() is true; child output is consumed in process and is not printed by the proposed harness.

source_ranges.label: V3t waits for the prefetch
source_ranges.meaning: V3t waits for Aeo's Promise only when the prefetch has started.

source_ranges.label: Main entry starts Aeo before CLI command dispatch
source_ranges.meaning: Aeo() is called during normal startup.

source_ranges.label: Root Commander preAction waits for MDM and keychain prefetch
source_ranges.meaning: await Promise.all([Det(), V3t()]) runs in common preAction. Det reads managed-settings state; the test leaves it intact.

source_ranges.label: Det wrapper awaits managed-settings loader
source_ranges.meaning: Det starts the per-host loader once and awaits its loadPromise.

source_ranges.label: Managed-settings loader reads MDM source and applies it
source_ranges.meaning: The loader calls eQr() ?? RTn(), awaits Wt(...) to produce MDM/HKCU settings, and stores the resulting managed settings.

source_ranges.label: --print option definition
source_ranges.meaning: Noninteractive print mode; help says the workspace trust dialog is skipped.

source_ranges.label: --bare help definition
source_ranges.meaning: Bare skips installed plugin hooks and keychain reads and sets CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1.

source_ranges.label: --include-hook-events option definition
source_ranges.meaning: Includes hook lifecycle events with stream-json output.

source_ranges.label: --plugin-dir option definition
source_ranges.meaning: Loads an explicit plugin directory for this session only.

source_ranges.label: --max-budget-usd option definition
source_ranges.meaning: Positive hard budget option for print mode.

bounded_native_attempts.classification: Actual Native plugin load and session.start hook execution observed; model response not reached because the local stub route was too strict.

bounded_native_attempts.result: Initial workspace sandbox denied binding 127.0.0.1 with EPERM; the subsequent reviewed run used the fixed local listener.

bounded_native_attempts.classification: Passed actual Native plugin load, session.start Mod API effect, and one -p completion against the local stub. The reported cost is Native's calculation from stub usage; no real provider was contacted.

acceptance.observed_native_mod_effect: The temporary plugin appeared in system/init and its session.start callback wrote the fixed marker in the temporary session cwd.
limits: One session.start callback and one turn only; no broader hook/API matrix was run.
Telemetry flags put Native telemetry mode in a non-default state, but this is not proof that every possible network path was disabled.
The stub served the exact loopback request and did not relay to an external provider.
